none: PAS NLM-7B1D15: Roman Nummus of House of Constantine from Kirmington
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), issue of 330-340, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Helmeted and mantled bust of Roma left. Obverse inscription: [VRBS ROMA]. Reverse description: Wolf suckling twins, two stars above. In exergue: PLG, for Lyons mint first officina. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 13.6mm, Weight: 1.03gms, die axis: 6
